alt: Official correspondence from the San Diego County District Attorney's Office Consumer Protection Team regarding Complaint Number 2026BC0308 against Grow Therapy Inc., dated June 15, 2026.
summary: This official correspondence from the Office of the San Diego County District Attorney (Summer Stephan, DA) confirms that Nicolas Hernandez's Consumer Protection complaint against Grow Therapy Inc. has been formally received, cataloged as Case File Complaint Number 2026BC0308, and assigned to the Economic Crimes Division & Consumer Protection Division for active regulatory review under California unfair competition and false advertising laws.
full_text: Office of the San Diego County District Attorney. Summer Stephan, District Attorney. Hall of Justice, 330 West Broadway, San Diego, CA 92101. Phone: (619) 531-4040. SanDiegoDA.com. Rachel Solov, Assistant District Attorney. June 15, 2026. Nicolas Hernandez. RE: Complaint Number 2026BC0308 / Grow Therapy Inc. Dear Nicolas Hernandez, Thank you for submitting your complaint to the San Diego County District Attorney's Office Consumer Protection Team. Please see subject line for your individual complaint number and the name of the business or information you are reporting. Your submission is currently under review. Once our review is complete, we will contact you with the results. If we determine there is insufficient evidence to file criminal charges, we will inform you of any alternative options you may have to resolve the matter. You can expect a written response within six weeks. If your complaint requires further investigation, we may refer you to the appropriate law enforcement agency or California regulatory body. Please note that the District Attorney's Office is primarily responsible for prosecuting criminal cases. Investigations, however, are typically conducted by law enforcement or regulatory agencies. Once a case has been fully investigated by the proper agency, it may then be referred to our office for review and potential prosecution. Please be aware that fraud and related investigations can be complex and may take several months or longer to complete. We appreciate your patience during this process. Additionally, many of the complaints received by our office involve civil disputes. The most appropriate remedy for such matters is often through a private civil lawsuit, either in Small Claims Court or Superior Court. To ensure the best use of public law enforcement resources, individual disputes between consumers and businesses are generally not prosecuted by this office. We encourage you to protect your rights and explore all available remedies. If you do not have an attorney, you may wish to contact the San Diego County Bar Association's Lawyer Referral Service at (619) 231-8585. For matters that fall under the jurisdiction of Small Claims Court, you may also contact the San Diego Superior Court's Small Claims Advisor at (858) 634-1777. Thank you for contacting the San Diego County District Attorney's Office. Economic Crimes Division & Consumer Protection Division. San Diego County District Attorney's Office. Phone: (619) 531-4070.
